label: Scope the record
title: Give a reported fault a record to follow.
detail: Define the assets, required fault details and actor labels before adding a status workflow. The scenario uses fictional workshop data.

label: Define the lifecycle
artifact: contract.json · five states and five legal transitions
title: Make each next step explicit.
detail: Assignment needs a technician label; resolution needs a treatment note. A resolved order can reopen, while a closed order stays closed.

label: Separate the services
artifact: Service interface · API service · browser demo
title: Share rules across two ways to try the app.
detail: The Vue interface uses either FastAPI with SQLite or an in-memory demo service. Both consume the same transition contract; their storage boundaries remain explicit.

label: Protect each change
artifact: Version check + atomic record and event writes
title: Keep the current record and its history together.
detail: The API rejects stale versions and commits a status update with its event in one SQLite transaction. If the event write fails, the change rolls back.

label: Challenge the rules
artifact: 25 state pairs · stale edits · rollback tests
title: Test the changes that must not get through.
detail: Exercise every origin and target pair, missing treatment notes and failed history writes. The 8–9 October 2026 record documents 37 API and 27 demo unit tests passing.

label: Package two ways to try it
artifact: Static demo + runnable API source + check results
title: Let a reviewer follow the evidence.
detail: Open the session-only browser demo or run the complete application locally. Source, reproduction commands and saved browser checks explain what each mode verifies.
